items.title: FileBrowser: Symlink following escapes user scope allowing arbitrary file read outside the served directory
items.summary: ## Summary File read paths resolve symbolic links with `filepath.EvalSymlinks` and then operate on the resolved target without re-checking that the target still lies inside the user's source/scope.
